decisions.reason: Confirm unstructured=true for the ref 'googlescholar' (cp 4642). Its body is only {{معرف جوجل سكولار}}, which produces a link to the subject's Google Scholar profile. No citation template is present (the guide's test is 'no citation template', section 3.1), and the footnote cites a source with a bare link, like the guide's bare-URL example. Ambiguity: an identifier template is not literally plain text, so unstructured=false is an arguable reading; the chosen reading follows the 'no citation template' test most closely.
